summary.text: Jake Bissaillon is a Democratic state senator who has represented Rhode Island State Senate District 1 since December 8, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Bissaillon was born in Lynn, Massachusetts.
He earned a bachelor's degree in 2009 and a graduate degree in 2010 from Providence College and a J.D. from Roger Williams University School of Law in 2016.
His career experience includes working in government.
